name: Stone bread oven
description: A domed bread oven of plastered stone on a waist-high fieldstone plinth, its stone front wall pierced by an arched mouth glowing with embers under a short flue; a long wooden peel leans against the plinth beside a few split logs.

provenance.prompt: A domed bread oven of plastered stone with an arched mouth and a peel leaning on it, about 1.5 × 1.5 × 1.6 m; anchors fire:hearth and light:fire.
